blocks.text: Safe zone at the heart of the city: no rifts, no monsters. The spawn faces the obelisk, with the city map and the city guide kiosks; around the square stand the Registry, the forge, the market (an open hanok hall of arms), the gem shops and the guild hall, and to the north the Hall of the Awakened (the leaderboards and their statues). A transit kiosk stands by the spawn.
